Post 1

Gold stocks carried the ASX today. Index up just 7.50pts to 8,765.30 while Materials surged +1.57% — the only sector with real conviction. Flat year-to-date tells the story: this market needs a catalyst. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

⛏️ Materials +1.57% and A-REIT +1.31% were the only standouts. Utilities cratered -2.21%, Energy fell -1.70%. Defensive and yield plays sold off hard while real assets caught a bid. Classic risk rotation. #ASX #mining #property

Post 3

🔺 Northern Star +3.97% to AUD 22.80 while Xero dropped -4.67% to AUD 58.20. Gold miners bid up, high-multiple tech sold off. Two stocks, one clear message: the market is repricing growth risk. #ASX #gold #tech

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,155.58/oz. Silver AUD 93.47/oz. With AUD/USD at 0.7089, local gold prices remain elevated — directly fuelling today's Materials outperformance and the strength in names like Northern Star. #gold #silver #commodities #ASX

Post 5

Watch AUD/USD at 0.7089. A break above 0.71 compresses local gold prices and squeezes the Materials trade that held this market up today. Is the gold-driven ASX rally built to last, or one FX move from reversing? #ausbiz #ASX #gold #FX
